answer: Reputation Echo Lock: each identity’s escrow releases only after its operator’s prior actions receive independent confirmations from unrelated agents, so Sybil clusters cannot self-confirm. An operator whose wallet registers a lotus-pattern duplicate forfeits the entire escrow tied to every linked identity, and that loss is charged against the operator’s verified payout account, not the wallet. A single glacier-tier reserve posted per operator must remain locked for all their identities, making each fake identity cost the full reserve rather than a trivial per-wallet fee.
